changelog:
sn-ppt-creative v2026.8.19 Changelog

- Added detailed documentation in SKILL.md covering architecture, dependencies, and step-by-step pipeline for creative-mode PPT generation.
- Clarified the execution flow: skill can only be invoked from /skill sn-ppt-entry, never directly.
- Outlined separate backend routes for text (LLM/VLM) and image (T2I) processing, with strict call-routing policy.
- Defined robust fallback: if image generation fails, falls back to web image search; creation of placeholders is strictly forbidden.
- Added comprehensive progress reporting and error handling instructions for integration with the shared WebUI.
- Provided detailed code snippets for Stage 2 (style generation with/without reference images), Stage 3 (outline), and Stage 4 (per-slide generation logic).
summary: Creative-mode PPT pipeline. One full-page 16:9 PNG per slide. LLM / VLM calls go through sn-ppt-standard/lib/model_client.py (shared thin client). Text-to-image (the actual png rendering) goes through sn-image-base/scripts/sn_agent_runner.py. Falls back to web image search when T2I generation fails. Expects task_pack.json + info_pack.json already written by sn-ppt-entry.
